T011 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YEuclid n)),
  (∀ (s δ : ℝ),
      0 < s →
        0 < δ →
          ∀ (V : ℕ → Set (YEuclid (n + 1))),
            yCover δ (yProd E) V → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → yContent s δ E ≤ yCost (s + 1) V + ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
    ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → yContent s δ E ≤ yContent (s + 1) δ (yProd E)
'Translation.T011' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
